text: Being here, I feel struck by a sense of modernity and curiosity. The glass-walled meeting room in the first scene radiates a quiet expectation, as if ideas are waiting to be shared within. The second image immerses me deeper into a world of innovation and research; the bold R&D display ignites my philosophical wonder about human creativity and our drive to know and shape the world. I sense excitement and openness—this place values exploration, collaboration, and the relentless pursuit of knowledge.
